articleTitle: Accelerator Implementation of Lenet-5 Convolution Neural Network Based on FPGA with HLS
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: Convolution neural network is widely used in image recognition because it can imitate the behavioral characteristics of biological visual nerve, and has high recognition accuracy. It is a kind of feed forward neural network which contains convolution computation and has deep structure. Also it is one of the representative algorithms of deep learning. Because the convolution neural network has a special calculation mode, the general processor is not high in the implementation efficiency of the convolution neural network and can not meet the performance requirements. In order to solve this problem, we implement convolution neural network on FPGA and optimize convolution operation to improve computing parallelism, data throughput and energy efficiency of traditional processors. Finally, we implemented the convolution neural network of the Lenet-5 model on the ZYBOZ7 FPGA board and compared it with traditional processor. We realized the fast recognition of a picture at the frequency of 100M Hz with DMA control. The data throughput of FPGA is more than four times higher than that of general processor., and the power consumption is 1.8W, which is much lower than that of general processor.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation of Security Maintenance Ability Base on AHP-Entropy
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: Based on the establishment of the evaluation index system of security maintenance ability, combined with AHP, entropy-weighted method and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model is constructed. Taking an unit as an example, the security maintenance ability evaluation value is obtained and the correctness of the model is verified. Through the evaluation result, the problems existing in the development process of the security maintenance ability are found.

articleTitle: Research on PMSM Speed Control System Based on Improved Reaching Law
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: In the research of performance optimization of permanent magnet synchronous motor speed control system, in order to solve the problems of slow starting speed, high chattering and poor robustness caused by large change of switching function in traditional exponential reaching law, an improved variable speed reaching law was proposed in this paper, based on the PMSM sliding mode variable speed control strategy. In the design process of speed controller, in order to eliminate the contradiction between large motor starting current and fast speed response, the speed error was introduced into the constant velocity term of the traditional exponential reaching law, the motion process was related to the speed of the system, which effectively solved the above problems. At the same time, the integral state variable was used to improve the control precision of the motor speed. The results of modeling and simulation in Matlab software show that the improved variable speed reaching law can better the dynamic performance of the motor speed control system.

articleTitle: A Booting Fingerprint of Device for Network Access Control
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: The rapid growth of the Internet of Things (IoT) is enhancing customers' experience with an ever-increasing mass of intelligent devices. However, the security doesn't get enough attention compared with novel concepts and features by manufactures which even not provide service of updates and patches. These issues could have been mitigated by the mechanism of the network access control. But traditional authentication mechanisms based on computational complexity of cryptographic protocols cannot be implemented on IoT devices with limited physical and computational resources. Therefore, we turn our attention to the device fingerprint which is like a biometric fingerprint that be able to provide identity authentication. The fingerprint proposed in this paper generated by network traffic features divided into the packet-feature and the IAT-feature. These features are extracted from the traffic when the device is booted, because at this time the device's network behavior is stable compared to other times. Experiments illustrate that the average identification accuracy of our device fingerprint reaches 92.4%.

articleTitle: Design of Wide Band Antenna Array for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a wide band antenna array for fifth-generation (5G) wireless cellular networks. The proposed antenna array is composed of 8 bow-tie shape radiation elements and a modified T power divider. The single bowtie shape antenna yields an S11<; -10dB bandwidth of 41.7% (28.5GHz-43.5GHz) and a maximum gain of 5dBi. For the antenna array design, two apertures in the ground at the feeding port are inserted to achieve a better performance. Due to the presence of the apertures, the antenna array resulted in a much better impedance matching and higher gain. The results show that <; -10dB S11 bandwidth spans from 36.6GHz to 42.8GHz with multibeam radiation pattern. The realized gain at each certain frequencies are around 8dB. The proposed antenna has good performances which is suitable for the coming 5G.

articleTitle: Research on Formal Modeling and Safety Analysis Method of Head-up Display System for Civil Aircraft Based on AltaRica
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: The application of head-up display system (HUDS) in civil aviation effectively enhances pilots' situational awareness and flight safety. It has become necessary avionics equipment for new civil aircraft. In this article, formal modeling and safety analysis method based on AltaRica language is proposed for solving the problem that the data of system design and safety analysis cannot be expressed uniformly existing in traditional safety analysis methods. Aiming at HUDS, formal AltaRica models are built, and the failure condition model is added to the system model, which effectively combines the system design with safety analysis. Meanwhile, a graphical modeling tool-Simfia is used to make the AltaRica model of HUDS visually, to achieve assessing formal safety of HUDS. The results show that it can combine modeling with system design based on AltaRica language, to achieve consistent representation of system design and safety assessment, and effectively support the iteration process of safety analysis and system design.

articleTitle: A High-Precision Time Delay Estimation Method Based on Fourth-Order Cumulant
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: Time delay is a very significant measurement in the field of detection and positioning. The accuracy of time delay estimation directly influences the precision and reliability of the positioning. Aiming at improving the accuracy of time delay estimation in positioning, a new method of high precision time delay estimation is proposed in this paper. Assuming the background noise as Gaussian distribution and Laplace distribution, the new method firstly performs auto-correlation and cross-correlation operation on the received signal to suppress noise initially, and then performs fourth order cumulant operation to further suppress noise and finally extract time delay information by cross correlation method. Comparing with generalized cross-correlation method, second-correlation method and high-order cumulant method, the new method can effectively suppress Gaussian noise and Laplace noise interference. The new method can achieve higher precision and obtain high precise detection and positioning. At last the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the new method.

articleTitle: Performance Study of Polypyrrole-nanowires Based Microbial Fuel Cells
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: In this study, polypyrrole (PPy)-based nanomaterials synthesized by electrochemical method were used as anode materials to improve the power output of microbial fuel cells (MFCs). The respective introduction of carbon dots and graphene into the PPy nanowires makes the surface morpology of carbon-based PPy nanocomposites more interesting than those of PPy nanomaterials, and the high specific surface area is more conducive to microbial adhesion. The maximum power density of mini-MFCs equipped with PPy-based nanocomposites as anodes increased by nearly 40% than the mini-MFCs equipped with PPy nanowires. This work suggests PPy-based nanocomposites be more promising materials as anodes in application of mini-MFC.

articleTitle: Smart Contract Defect Detection Based on Parallel Symbolic Execution
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: There are more than 1 million smart contracts in Ethereum and the number of ethers managed by smart contracts has exceeded 100 million, but the security vulnerabilities in smart contracts seriously jeopardize the financial security of Ethereum users. Existing method for defect detection of smart contract bytecode using symbolic execution does not take care of the accuracy and detection realtime at same time. In this paper a smart contract bytecode defect detection algorithm based on parallel symbolic execution is proposed. We split a smart contract in units of functions by analyzing the smart contract function selection process. A symbolic execution tree is constructed for each function to predict the function execution path. Then we partition the symbolic execution tree into multiple sub-trees evenly. Finally, a process pool is used to perform parallel symbolic execution on those sub-trees to reduce the analysis time of smart contract defect detection. Experimental data shows our method has a significant improvement in detection efficiency compared with existing symbolic execution method. The speedup ratio is up to 3.1x in a 4-core computer. Besides, it does not introduce false positives or false negatives.

articleTitle: Heavy ion-and Proton-induced SEU Simulation and Error Rates Calculation in 0.15um SRAM-based FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: Simulation on the SEU sensitive area shows that the SRAM cell of 0.15um FPGA has separate sensitive regions, and particles with large LET can cause upset from larger extent of areas. The area of sensitive volumes can extend beyond the boundary of the bit cell<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sub>The Simulation result is compared to the measured SEU cross-sections from experiments under accelerators. Composite sensitive volume model of a 0.15um FPGA chip has been established based on the results of Fully-Physical SEU simulation, which describes the upset process more accurately. The SEU rates calculated with the RPP/IRPP model and the composite sensitive volume model are compared against data obtained from in-flight test.

articleTitle: Design of a Stored-value Card Platform Based on Smart Contract
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: Stored-value cards are used more and more widely. But there are some problems in the present stored-value card platform: 1. The service agreement of stored-value card is not clear enough; 2. The refund process of users is inconvenient; 3. The transfer of stored-value can not be realized among users; 4. The security of accounts is not guaranteed. Smart contracts are computer contracts written in code, which are enforced directly by computers. This paper proposes a stored-value card platform in which the service contracts are expressed with smart contracts. The smart contract is executed on the blockchain. Blockchain technology, in which accounts are decentralized and data is resistant to modification, is applied to improving reliability in the consumption process. The platform is built on the private blockchains of Ethereum, which is designed for small merchants. ECDSA (Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithms) is used to asymmetrically encrypt accounts. Some functions, such as stored-value issuance, stored-value consumption, commodity purchase, are designed in this system.

articleTitle: Carbon Dots/Graphene Hybrids for UV Photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: The intrinsical poor optical absorption and short carrier lifetime of graphene have restricted its practical application of photodetectors. Carbon dots (CDs) have received much attention due to their fascinating optical properties, environmentally-friendly nature, small size and superiority of a large optical absorptivity. Thus, in this work, hybrid photodetector of graphene and CDs has been proposed for the deep-UV photodetection, in which CDs integrated with graphene to form a planar hybrid structure. An inverse photoelectricity response was observed after illumination, which means the decline of conductivity under irradiation. The mechanism for this behavior is attributed to the built-in electric field generated across the interface between graphene layer and CDs layer, which separates the photogenerated electrons and holes, and promotes the holes to graphene layer and electrons to CDs layer. Our result demonstrates that the integration of graphene and CDs shows better optical absorption and wavelength selectivity. Together with the mechanism, it paves a step for practical applications of quantum dots sensitized graphene-based photodetectors.

articleTitle: The Rearch on Improved LVQ Neural Network Method
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: By analyzing the basic structure and algorithm of LVQ neural network and its deformation, this paper studies the breast tumor diagnosis method based on improved LVQ neural network. The LVQ neural network needs to process all input features, because the input feature dimension is too large, the redundant information is too much, the training takes too long, so apply PCA algorithm to preprocess the input features. In essence, PCA algorithm takes the direction with the largest variance as its main feature and “de-correlates” the data in each orthogonal direction. It is a parameterless technology without the intervention of subjective parameters, so PCA is convenient for general implementation. In this paper, PCA algorithm is proposed to optimize LVQ neural network, and the results are compared with LVQ neural network. The results show that the optimized LVQ neural network by PCA has shorter running time and higher diagnostic accuracy than LVQ neural network.

articleTitle: The Performance Analysis of Second Order Band-pass Filter
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: The design of Band-pass filter is an important component in electronic circuits. The center frequency, bandwidth and phase-shift are most concerned parameters in design. We analyze the transfer function performance of second-order passive band-pass filter in this paper. The constraint conditions between center frequency, bandwidth and phase-shift are derived. In consideration of the fact that active filter is consisted by passive filters and active components. The derived constraint conditions are the same with active band-pass filters.

articleTitle: Gas Sensor Based on Surface Acoustic Waves Using Zinc Oxide Piezoelectric Thin Films
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: Gas sensor based on surface acoustic wave (SAW) using piezoelectric zinc oxide (ZnO) thin film was simulated with COMSOL. The gas sensor is designed with an inter-digital transducer (IDT) on a ZnO substrate and covered with a thin polyisobutylene (PIB). The results show that there are the resonant frequency and ant-resonant frequency of SAW in the ZnO substrate arising from the electrode effect of the IDT, and deformed shape of the resonance SAW mode is different with that of anti-resonance SAW mode. The effect of the dichloromethane (DCM) on the gas sensor was also researched. Because the mass of the PIB film increases with PIB selectively adsorbing DCM in air, a shift in resonance to a slightly lower frequency was found.

articleTitle: Frequency Splitting Analysis of Electric-Field Coupled Wireless Power Transfer System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: Frequency splitting appears in the electromagnetic coupled resonant and electric-field coupled wireless power transfer (ECPT) system. However, there are few researches concerning the phenomenon in the ECPT system. Based on the 2-port network impedance matching theory, the paper analyzes the impedance matching of the ECPT system with coupling capacitor double resonance topology. Frequency splitting of load power only occurs in over coupling state, and load power can reaches the maximum as the coupling capacitor change though the operating frequency tuning when the topology is symmetric structures.

articleTitle: COM Based Channel-Compliance Analysis and Its Comparison with BER-Way for 25 Gbps NRZ Serial Link
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: This paper investigates Channel Operating Margin (COM) and traditional statistical eye/BER analysis for 25 Gb/s NRZ serial link. First, the detail calculation of COM is derived from the pulse response in order to evaluate the channel-compliance. Then, by using advance design system (ADS), the high speed link including FFE and DFE is established. Finally, the comparison between these two ways of channel-compliance evaluation is given. Simulation results that both of them can evaluate the effects of attenuation caused by device package and influence resulted from crosstalk. COM-way can evaluate the effects quantitatively while BER-way can evaluate the effects qualitatively.

articleTitle: Research on the Fringing-Field Effect of LCoS Devices with Opposite Pretilt Angles for Adjacent Pixels
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: In order to research on influence of the fringe field effects caused by high-resolution Liquid Crystal on Silicon (LCoS) devices, a working mode of LCoS device with opposite pretilt angles for adjacent pixels is designed in this paper. Firstly, the method of calculating the phase-modulation rate of liquid crystal devices is introduced. Then, the distribution of phase modulation of high-resolution LCoS devices in this working mode are simulated by using the TechWizLCD software and software Matlab. Finally, the influence of fringe field effect on phase modulation characteristics of LCoS devices in this working mode is analyzed by comparing phase modulation characteristics with traditional anti-parallel mode (ECB mode). The results show that this working mode restrains the fringe field effects on the adjacent pixels on both sides of the target pixel, while the fringe field effects on the pixel edges of the other pixels is enhanced.

articleTitle: Intelligent Orthopedic Vest Based on Flexible Tactile Sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: In this paper, a capacitive flexible tactile sensor has been designed by using PORON material and conductive film. It has the characteristics of small size, high flexibility and good pressure detection ability. At the same time, the sensor has been used to reconstruct the traditional orthopaedic vest. According to the change of tactile pressure, the posture of human body is detected, and the classification of normal, hunchback, left-leaning and right-leaning postures is completed in real time. If the user is in abnormal posture, it will give a vibration warning.

articleTitle: Phase Waveform Extraction and Coupling Noise Prediction of Buck Converter in Printed Circuit Boards
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: field programmable gate arrays; radiation hardening (electronics); zinc compounds; impedance matching; graphene; learning (artificial intelligence); II-VI semiconductors; wide band gap semiconductors; logic design; liquid crystal on silicon.

articleTitle: Long-Term Effect of Visual Fatigue Caused by LEDs with Modulated Light
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: The visual fatigue caused by long-term work under steady light generated by fluorescent luminaires and fluctuated light generated by LED luminaires with different modulation depth was investigated through subjective reports of symptoms and physiological signals. Both the subjective feelings and the physiological results show that visual fatigue becomes more serious with increasing time under all the test lighting conditions. Compared to fluorescent luminaires, the LED luminaires with full-modulated light produced significantly severer symptoms. However, the LEDs with 75% modulation depth was fully accepted.

articleTitle: A Novel FPGA-Based Digital Power Controller Architecture
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: In this paper, we design a novel controller based on modular bus software and hardware architecture. The proposed controller uses the FPGA as the hardware carrier, and integrates the external expansion type Avalon bus with the discrete IP module structure to realize the all-digital, efficient and reliable fast closed-loop regulation power control. Based on the requirements of the original related functions, the digital controller greatly reduces the FPGA resource consumption and improves the efficiency of hardware resources. Meanwhile, it provides a powerful experimental data reference for the modular design of the digital power controller. Moreover, the designed controller is successfully applied on Cooler Storage Ring of the Heavy Ion Research Facility in Lanzhou (HIRFL-CSR) six-pole magnet power supply.

articleTitle: A 40-nm CMOS 90-GHz Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: A 90-GHz transformer-based power amplifier (PA) is presented in this paper. The amplifier consists of two common-source pseudo-differential stages. To improve the amplifier gain and bandwidth performance in a compact size, a low loss impedance matching network is utilized. Test results show that a small-signal gain of 14 dB is achieved at 90 GHz and its bandwidth is larger than 15 GHz. Under 1V supply voltage, its 1-dB compression output power (OP <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1dB</sub>) is 13 dBm. Fabricated in a 40 nm CMOS technology, the chip occupies a core area of about 0.3 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Cold Cathode X-ray Tube with MgO Composite Gate Structure
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: In a triode field emission structure, the anode current is reduced due to the trapping of the field emission electrons by the metal gate mesh. We propose a composite structure with the MgO film evaporated on the surface of metal gate. The effect of the composite gate on the field emission of the CNTs cold cathode was studied. The cold cathode X-ray tube based on the composite gate was designed. Compared with the metal gate structure, the X-ray tube using the composite gate is stable, the anode current is greatly improved, and the electron transmittance is increased by more than 30%, which can reach 80%. It can be considered that the secondary electrons emitted from the MgO film, not only compensate the intercepted current, but also become part of the emission current, thereby improving the anode current.

articleTitle: Design and Application of DDR3 SDRAM in LCoS Logic Control
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: A Liquid Crystal on Silicon (LCoS) display system with resolution of 1280 ×1024 is designed and driven by FPGA (Field-Programmable Gate Array). The system uses DDR3 SDRAM (Double Data Rate3 Synchronous Dynamic Random Access Memory), combining the DDR3 MIG core with read/write timing and FIFO (First-in First out) technology, and achieves a 180Hz field sequential driving display on LCoS.

articleTitle: A Packaging Method to Improve Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells with YAG:Ce Phosphors
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: A packaging method to improve the conversion efficiency of monocrystalline silicon solar cells is presented. In this method, Ce-doped yttrium aluminum garnet (YAG:Ce) phosphor particles as luminescence down-shifting materials are coated on the surface of the solar cells which are then packaged with ethylene vinyl acetate (EVA) and glass. The experimental results show that, after being packaged, the increase in the conversion efficiency is from 17.24% to 18.13%. The enhancement can be attributed to the luminescence down-shifting effect of YAG:Ce phosphors which convert ultraviolet/blue light into yellow light, the reduced reflection in the wavelength range below 480nm and the absorption of the light which is emitted from the phosphor particles and reflected back at air/glass interface. This method provides a potential way to improve the solar cells through the packaging processes, which is appliable for industries.

articleTitle: Development of Real-Time Style Transfer for Video System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: Re-drawing the image as a certain artistic style is considered to be a complicated task for computer machine. On the contrary, human can easily master the method to compose and describe the style between different images. In the past, many researchers studying on the deep neural networks had found an appropriate representation of the artistic style using perceptual loss and style reconstruction loss. In the previous works, Gatys et al. proposed an artificial system based on convolutional neural networks that creates artistic images of high perceptual quality. Whereas in terms of running speed, it was relatively time-consuming, thus it cannot apply to video style transfer. Recently, a feed-forward CNN approach has shown the potential of fast style transformation, which is an end-to-end system without hundreds of iteration while transferring. We combined the benefits of both approaches, optimized the feed-forward network and defined time loss function to make it possible to implement the style transfer on video in real time. In contrast to the past method, our method runs in real time with higher resolution while creating competitive visually pleasing and temporally consistent experimental results.

articleTitle: Simulation and Calculation Method of Total Ionizing Dose Radiation Resistance of Aerospace Components based on in-Orbit Data
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: In this paper, a simulation method for the total ionizing dose resistance of aerospace components based on in-orbit empirical data is presented. Firstly, according to the overall layout of the whole satellite, a three-dimensional equivalent model of internal radiation shielding is established. Then, combined with the space radiation model of the earth radiation belt and the orbit and flight time of the whole satellite, dose-depth curves are given to calculate the transport capacity of particles through different material thicknesses. Finally, based on ray tracing and Monte Carlo simulation method, the satellite is completed by FASTRAD software. The three-dimensional quantitative calculation of internal radiation dose gives the specific anti-total dose radiation capability of components. In this paper, a three-dimensional equivalent model of radiation shielding in satellite is used to calculate the cumulative radiation dose of components. Through this method, the specific index of total ionizing dose radiation resistance of on-orbit empirical data device can be given, which is convenient for the device to continue to be used in other models, and provides an important guarantee for reducing ground radiation resistance verification test, saving cost and shortening the quality assurance period of aerospace devices in the future.

articleTitle: Modelling and Analysis of Electrical Stinger in a Silicon Metal Submerged Arc Furnace
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: In silicon metal furnaces, effective tapping requires a tool called a stinger; an energized graphite rod/pencil, fed by high current electrical power. A relatively high-localized current at the tap-hole opens it up and maintains the free flow of the silicon metal. The aim of this study is to estimate the electrical parameters of a stinger. The lack of system operation data of a stinger has contributed to the difficulty in designing the stinger as well as improving the safety of its operation. The model of the electrical stinger in this paper addresses two challenges: the limitation of the short circuit current by adding an inline inductor in the circuit and establishing the best operating current of a stinger. Operators' interviews and logging of real time data using instrumentation was part of the methodology used to get up to date data. The collected data was the basis of calculating the electrical parameters and modelling of the stinger.

articleTitle: Research on Deep-UV Photodetectors Based on Carbon Dots as Reactive Layer
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: Deep-ultraviolet (DUV) photodetectors are attracting attention due to their important applications in various fields. In this paper, carbon dots are used as an active layer to fabricate DUV photodetectors. These devices are capable of detecting UV light at wavelengths below 320 nm. Carbon dots are prepared by electrochemical method using distilled water as the electrolyte and their properties were characterized. A planar photoconductive structure is designed using carbon dots as reactive layer to prepare effective device by processes such as thermal evaporation and the performance of the device was estimated. The results show that the absorption peak of the carbon dots prepared by the electrochemical method is around 230 nm. A photodetector fabricated with carbon dots as an active layer has a good response at 254 nm illumination and the ratio of photocurrent to dark current of the device reaches 188.

articleTitle: Study on CMOS Sensor Irradiation Damage and Evaluation of System Performance Degradation
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: The CMOS sensor in space optical communication system may generate irradiation-induced noise, leading to deviation of image centroid. Total ionization dose (TID) test and displacement damage (DD) test are carried out. It shows that dark current increases 56.6times and 15.3 times, respectively. The quality of imaging decreases with the irradiation-induced bad points increasing. Based on test, simulated defect spots have been used for calculating the image centroid value by grey-level centroid algorithm. It shows that Centroid deviation value is about 1 pixel for the point defects case, while it is about 6 pixels for all random defects case. Both the amount and position of defect pixels contribute to deviation of image centroid and the accuracy decreasing. For the given optical communication system, When the deviation value of centroid position is 1pixel, beam direction changes about 6μrad, having a serious effect.

articleTitle: Electrostatic Discharge Characteristics Simulation of Printed-Circuit-Board with Full-Wave Model
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: A 3D full-wave model is used to investigate the electrostatic discharge characteristics of a Printed-Circuit-Board(PCB). The characteristics of electromagnetic field, the pin voltage and current waveforms of the components on a PCB are investigated. The simulation results briefly elaborate the influence of discharge point, signal line and via on electrostatic discharge.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Radio Tomographic Imaging Localization Method Based on Low-cost Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: As one of the main methods of device free localization (DFL) that can locate a target without attaching any devices, the radio tomographic imaging (RTI) method based on the low-cost wireless sensor network (WSN) has wide application prospects. The current RTI positioning methods mainly determine a target position by searching the maximum brightness pixel in a RTI map. However, due to the existence of environmental noises and interference, the brightness of the pseudo-target is often greater than that of the real target, resulting in a misjudgment of the target and even a great positioning error. In this paper, an enhanced RTI (E-RTI) positioning method that combines target shape features with the target brightness feature is proposed for overcoming this problem. This method can effectively reduce the negative influence of pseudo-targets and environmental noises by using the target shape prior information. The experimental results show that the positioning accuracy of this method is better than the existing RTI method.

articleTitle: Research on Registration Algorithm Based on Image Mutual Information
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: Digital image registration technology is a process of image registration for one or more images obtained from different sensors, different shooting environments and different shooting angles in the same scene. The quality of registration directly affects the quality of subsequent image processing. The multi-camera image fusion can greatly improve the imaging effect of the picture. In this paper, based on two images taken at the same time in parallel coordinate system, an image registration method based on mutual information (gray distribution matrix of left and right images) has been proposed, which realized the left-right image alignment in pixel level. It effectively solved the problem of fusion shadow and faults caused by parallax between left and right images after registration. The experimental results showed that this method has a good registration effect for both the far and near scenes.

articleTitle: Radiation Hardness Design and Test Verification of Program Configuration Module Based on Commercial Devices
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: A low-cost and radiation-hardened program configuration module was designed with Commercial devices. Radiation hardness strategies, such as Error Correction Codes combined with multi-sector redundancy, and active reconfiguration, were designed to strength the radiation tolerance of the module. Cross-section data of the module tested in the accelerator environment is compared with the data of devices used in the module that has no radiation hardness.

articleTitle: Pumped Stimulated Vertical Cavity Surface Emitting Laser by Solution-processed Method
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: In this paper, It is fully demonstrated that the characteristics of the vertical cavity surface emitting laser (VCSEL) can be versatilely engineered by independent adjustment of the cavity and solution-processable CdSe/ZnS quantum dots (QDs), featuring low threshold (8.9 µJ/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>), directional output (beam divergence of ≈ 10 degree), and favorable stability. Importantly, the lasing wavelength can be broadcasted to cover across the red, green, and blue region maintaining comparable thresholds, which is promising in developing single-source-pumped full-color visible lasers. The results unambiguously reveal the feasibility of CdSe/ZnS QDs as practical laser media.

articleTitle: Research on Safety Level DCS Automated Test Method Based on Symbolic Execution
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: Nuclear power plant safety-level DCS (Distributed Control System) is the central nerve of the entire nuclear power plant, ensuring the safety and reliability of safety-level DCS application software is crucial. The safety-level DCS has to deal with different working conditions, and the corresponding DCS software has to perform different signal processing processes, and each processing process forms a software path. The safety-level DCS serves as a safety protection for nuclear power plants and requires the desired results for each path. Testing the path is an important way to ensure software reliability. This paper uses symbolic execution to do automated path testing of nuclear safety-level DCS application software, and gives a complete automated testing methods. This gives a new idea to automated testing of DCS software paths.

articleTitle: Enhancement of the Diffraction Efficiency on Volume Holographic Gratings by Silver Nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: The diffraction efficiency of volume holographic gratings is one of the main factors of holographic imaging quality. A volume holographic grating is prepared by interference of two light beams and coupled with silver nanoparticles to improve the diffraction efficiency. The simulation was carried out with FDTD Solutions software. In TE mode, the diffraction efficiency before and after grating coupling is basically unchanged; while in TM mode, the diffraction efficiency is improved by 6% and the center wavelength is unchanged. The experimental results are also consistent with the simulation. The relative increase rate τ of the coupling grating diffraction efficiency in TM mode is 6%~16.2%. Diffraction enhancement is due to the local plasmon resonance characteristics of silver nanoparticles.

articleTitle: A Low Level Pulse GOA Circuit Consisted of a-IGZO TFT
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: In order to compensate the threshold voltage variation, the AMOLED compensative pixel circuit needs to be driven by multi-pulse signals which have continuous high/low level pulses. By using traditional gate driver on array (GOA) with amorphous indium-gallium-zinc-oxide (a-IGZO), we can achieve the high level pulse. But under the same process, the low level pulse is hardly got. In this paper, novel low level pulse integrated gate driver circuit for AMOLED pixel compensation purpose are presented. The simulation results show that this circuit works successfully.

articleTitle: The Experiment and Simulation Calculation Study on SEU Hardened Effect of Flash FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: For Flash FPGA used in space, Single event upset (SEU) will happen caused by the high energy particle. The Mechanism of SEU and the measures of device hardened have been introduced. SEU hardened design is done for BRAM and register of a Flash FPGA. Single event effect test is performed to verify the measures. It shows the SEU cross section reduces 2 orders and 75% for BRAM and register, respectively. Based on the integral method between LET flux spectrum and SEU cross section, SEU rate is calculated for different orbits. It reduces 4-5 orders for hardened BRAM and 2-3 orders for hardened register.

articleTitle: The Effect of Luminance on Visual Perception Based on Eye Movement and ECG
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: Display technology has been developing rapidly, and HDR, QLED and other new technologies provided the viewers with higher luminance and better dynamic contrast. However, too much light emission from the devices may cause glare or the perception of visual discomfort. This paper explored the effect of white luminance on visual perception using subjective rating, electrocardiogram and eye movement tracking. Using univariate ANOVA method, the results show that higher luminance can improve the display quality but ruin the perception of viewing preference. And the optimum luminance 130 cd/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>is recommended for better viewing experience and less visual discomfort.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation Method of Cloth under the Low Velocity Flow Field
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: With the development of computer technology, the simulation of fabrics has been widely used in many aspects of production and life. This paper focuses on the physical performance of a specific fabric under Low Velocity Flow Field, which more realistically restores the movement of the fabric in low-speed airflow. It is combined the quasi-steady-state mechanical model based on aerodynamic theory with the classical structural mechanics model of cloth. By cyclically calculating the displacement and deformation of the cloth dot at different times, the cloth motion animation can be obtained. The experimental results show that through the combination with the Mass-Spring Model and the Non-planar Vortex Lattice Method, the fabric simulation effect with third dimension can be obtained.

articleTitle: A Method for Determining the Optimal Configuration Parameters of Core Wire Interconnection for the Electrical Properties of Microwave Components
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: Microwave circuits and modules are widely used in communication, navigation, detection and other fields. Under the requirement of increasingly miniaturization, integration, high frequency and high reliability of microwave modules, the change of interconnection configuration of circuit modules in microwave modules will have a significant impact on the signal transmission performance. The interconnection configuration of core wire is modeled by parameterized characterization, and the correlation mechanism between interconnection configuration and electrical performance is studied, so as to determine the optimal interconnection configuration parameters for electrical performance transmission, which can significantly improve the interconnection signal transmission performance and guarantee the working quality of highperformance electronic equipment.

articleTitle: Passively Q-Switched Nd:YVO4 Laser Based on Silver-Plated Graphene Saturable Absorber
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: We demonstrate a passively Q-Switched solid state pulse laser based on silver-plated Graphene as a saturable absorber (SA). The pulsed laser operating at 1064.1 nm was realized at the threshold of 2.2 W. The pulse repetition rate of the laser can be widely changed from 0.102 to 1.29 MHz, the maximum output power and the narrowest pulse width are 509.2 mW and 280 ns, respectively.

articleTitle: Real-time Video Image Super-Resolution Network for Mobile Terminals
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: A lightweight video image super-resolution (SR) neural network and its processing system, which is aimed for real-time video processing of mobile terminals, has been developed. The result showed that the system with the edge calculation device is feasible. We choose the PYNQ-z2 as the mobile terminal to transplant our algorithm. When the input size is 200×200 and the upscale is x2, the time cost can be no more than 65ms with the system.

articleTitle: Portable Circuit Design Based on SERF Atomic Magnetometer
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: In this design, we realized the control of SERF atomic magnetometer from the perspective of circuit, which involves the abstraction of model and equivalent substitution. To achieve portability and miniaturization, we realized the functional replacement of the corresponding instrument with a custom-made PCB. Experiment result showed that we have completed the whole process of magnetic field measurement. This provides a proof of principle for miniaturization and portability of SERF atomic magnetometer. The sensitivity of atomic magnetometer estimates 200pT/Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup>. In the future, we need to optimize the circuit platform to increase the sensitivity of atomic magnetometer.

articleTitle: Predicting Decision-making Using Item Response Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: Predicting consumers decision making is significant for improving retail performance. To reflect the shopping process, eye movement data is tracked. The relationship between eye tracking data and decision making is analyzed using item response theory. A decision predicting model is given with the parameters, like observation time and number of roundtrips. Influence of color characterization on the decision making is also studied. The results show that luminance will impact the decision making behavior more significantly than saturation.

articleTitle: Control Strategy and Simulation of Tracking System under Acceleration Limit
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: Tracking system is an important part of the inter-satellite laser communication terminal. The motion in the tracking system affects the inertia stabilization of the entire communication terminal. Therefore, the acceleration of the laser communication terminal must be limited when tracking the target. In this paper, the tracking control strategy of laser communication terminal under acceleration limit was studied and analyzed. We also use Matlab for simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Fast Image Defogging Algorithm Design Based on Dark Channel Prior
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: Foggy weather brings unfavorable influences to transportation, visual sensing, security and so on. Although some traditional algorithms have excellent processing effects on computers, it is difficult to implement on platforms with high real-time requirements such as self-driving and aerial photography. In this paper, one simple but efficient algorithm has been proposed to meet the requirement of real-time image defogging. Instead of dividing by squares, continuous plane detection strategy has been adopted so that one foggy image can be divided into many continuous parts marked by one independent label, avoiding the blocking effect of image processing. Based on Dark Channel Prior (DCP), estimate of atmospheric light and transmission function seems no longer troublesome. Meanwhile, downsampling has been used suitably to decrease the computational complexity of intermediate processes while avoiding loss of precision. Finally, we achieved much faster single image defogging speed as well as better PSNR and SSIM.

articleTitle: IoT Multi-control Bionic Manipulator's Design
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: This design uses STM32 microcontroller as the core controller of the mechanical arm, transplants Linux operating system to the S3C2440 development board and establishes the LAN server, realizes multiple functions and a variety of control mode: Android mobile app, personal PC in the local area network and gesture-sensing gloves can be used to control mechanical arm, it can also make the operation automatically. At the same time, because the server built, Linux system and QT interface transplanted are on S3C2440, so that the development board and all computers in the local area network can monitor the mechanical arm. This design is widely used in the field of intelligent industry, environmental exploration, intelligent home and so on.

articleTitle: Rare Failure Prediction via Event Matching for Aerospace Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: In this paper, we consider a problem of failure prediction in the context of predictive maintenance applications. We present a new approach for rare failures prediction, based on a general methodology, which takes into account peculiar properties of technical systems. We illustrate the applicability of the method on the real-world test cases from aircraft operations.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Modelling and Simulation Validation for Distributed PV Array System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: Solar energy has been considered as one of the promising energy sources. The construction of the solar photovoltaic (PV) plants has brought modelling issues. The accurate and efficient full system model is crucial for performance evaluation. Most of the existing theoretical studies focus on partial modelling and there are not many studies focus on full system modelling. The main aim of this paper is to provide a realistic mathematical modelling for the major system components for precise performance assessment. Firstly, the system is tested under different solar irradiance levels and constant ambient temperature for the constant load. Secondly, the system is tested at low irradiance level and maintaining a constant ambient temperature for different loads. The results of the system models under the different testing conditions precisely draw the system behavior based on the mathematical expression. The proposed models accurately disclosure the system behavior under different working conditions. The results also have provided a realistic and efficient system performance evaluation. Comparing the results of the system behaviour under different working conditions with and without battery storage, using battery storage has shown better system power reliability.
